verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an API platform that ships SDKs, an MCP server and a Console, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking or any opt-out control; the pack covers only payments, data, webhooks, signing and MCP features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
